video_title: Tristan Thompson joins The Richard Show | NBA Finals 10-Year Reunion

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the exhaustion of playing against Draymond Green and LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: What's more exhausting: boxing out Draymond for seven games, keeping up with LeBron, or being Tristan Thompson?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: What's more exhausting: boxing out Draymond for seven games, keeping up with LeBron when he's in full control mode, or being Tristan Thompson on the internet?

text_blocks.speaker: Tristan Thompson
text_blocks.text: Probably being Tristan Thompson on the internet. That's tough. Whatever I say.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's impact as a screen setter and offensive rebounder
quotes.excerpt: Living proof that a screen, a tip out and relentless timing can change history
quotes.quote: You are living proof that a screen, a tip out and relentless timing can change history just as much as a step back.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Cavs players had a group chat without Tristan Thompson
quotes.excerpt: We just kind of revealed that we have a group chat without you.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: How long did you realize we just kind of revealed that we have a group chat without you?

text_blocks.speaker: Tristan Thompson
text_blocks.text: I just realized that when I was watching social media. I was like, damn, you guys could have just said it in the group chat.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson ranks the 2015, 2016, and 2018 Cavaliers teams
quotes.excerpt: Start 2016, bench 2015, and I'm going to cut 2018.
quotes.quote: Start 2016, bench 2015, and I'm going to cut 2018. 2018 was a monster, but it was just a rough one.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The infamous J.R. Smith blunder in the 2018 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: We know why. Everyone needed to know the scoreboard.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: We know why. Everyone needed to know the scoreboard.

text_blocks.speaker: Tristan Thompson
text_blocks.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Everyone needed to know the scoreboard.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's defensive strategy against Stephen Curry in the Finals
quotes.excerpt: I think in the Finals we actually did a good job on Steph.
quotes.quote: I think in the Finals we actually did a good job on Steph. He didn't really go for 40s. His numbers weren't the greatest.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson's top point guards of all time
quotes.excerpt: For me, it's Magic Johnson and then Steph.
quotes.quote: For me, it's Magic Johnson and then Steph.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson on his motivation for offensive rebounding
quotes.excerpt: I was trying to get that extension deal, right? I was fighting for my life.
quotes.quote: I was trying to get that extension deal, right? I was fighting for my life.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson on the professionalism learned from LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Being the ultimate pro, getting in early, take your craft serious and not cheating the system.
quotes.quote: Being the ultimate pro, getting in early, take your craft serious and not cheating the system. Tyronn Lue told me before Game 6, if we go down in Game 6, I'm going to play you the last couple minutes just to get you right because for Game 7, I don't care what nobody says, I'm going with my dogs.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson on the star-studded rivalry between the Cavs and Warriors
quotes.excerpt: You had so many big names. If you look at the names right now, it's crazy.
quotes.quote: I think the stars behind it. You had so many big names. If you look at the names right now, it's crazy. Klay, Draymond, Andre Iguodala, me, you, Kevin Love, LeBron.
